legend: Doremy lives in a country consisting of n%%ZSMJ0%% cities numbered from 1%%ZSMJ1%% to n%%ZSMJ2%%, with ai%%ZSMJ3%% people living in the i%%ZSMJ4%%-th city. It can be modeled as an undirected graph with n%%ZSMJ5%% nodes.
Initially, there are no edges in the graph. Now Doremy wants to make the graph connected.
To do this, she can add an edge between i%%ZSMJ6%% and j%%ZSMJ7%% if
where S%%ZSMJ9%% is the set of all the nodes that are currently in the same connected component of either i%%ZSMJ10%% or j%%ZSMJ11%%, and c%%ZSMJ12%% is a given constant.
Can Doremy make the graph connected?
Two nodes (i,j)%%ZSMJ13%% are in the same connected component if there exists a path from i%%ZSMJ14%% to j%%ZSMJ15%%. A graph is connected if all its nodes are in the same connected component.
input: The input consists of multiple test cases. The first line contains a single integer t%%ZSMJ16%% (1≤t≤104%%ZSMJ17%%) — the number of test cases. The description of the test cases follows.
The first line contains two integers n%%ZSMJ18%%, c%%ZSMJ19%% (2≤n≤2⋅105%%ZSMJ20%%, 1≤c≤106%%ZSMJ21%%) — the number of nodes and the constant.
The second line of each test case contains n%%ZSMJ22%% integers a1,a2,…,an%%ZSMJ23%% (0≤ai≤1012%%ZSMJ24%%) — the number of people living in the i%%ZSMJ25%%-th city.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n%%ZSMJ26%% over all test cases does not exceed 2⋅105%%ZSMJ27%%.
output: For each test case, print "YES" (without quotes), if it is possible to make the graph connected, and "NO" (without quotes) otherwise.
You can print letters in any case (upper or lower).
note: In the first test case, Doremy can add edges in the following order:
Add (1,2)%%ZSMJ28%%. This operation is valid because a1+a2=20≥i⋅j⋅c=20%%ZSMJ29%%.
Add (1,3)%%ZSMJ30%%. This operation is valid because a1+a2+a3=35≥i⋅j⋅c=30%%ZSMJ31%%.
Add (1,4)%%ZSMJ32%%. This operation is valid because a1+a2+a3+a4=45≥i⋅j⋅c=40%%ZSMJ33%%.
In the second test case, Doremy can add edge (1,2)%%ZSMJ34%% because a1+a2=2≥1⋅2⋅1%%ZSMJ35%%. After that, the graph is connected.
In the third test case, Doremy can add edges in the order (5,4)%%ZSMJ36%%, (5,3)%%ZSMJ37%%, (5,2)%%ZSMJ38%% and (5,1)%%ZSMJ39%%.
In the fourth test case, Doremy cannot add any edge at all.
